_about: SERIES SHELF of the Pali Buddhist canon in English before 1931, from the three great translation projects outside the Sacred Books of the East: the Cambridge Jataka (6 vols, 1895-1907, ed. E. B. Cowell: Chalmers, Rouse, Francis, Neil, Cowell), the Sacred Books of the Buddhists (Rhys Davids's Dialogues of the Buddha, 1899-1921; Chalmers's Further Dialogues vol. II, 1927), the Pali Text Society translations (Mrs Rhys Davids's Psalms of the Early Buddhists, 1909-13; Geiger and Bode's Mahavamsa, 1912) and the Harvard Oriental Series (Warren's Buddhism in Translations, 1896; Burlingame's Buddhist Legends, 1921). Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only; the Luzac and Motilal reprints of the 1950s-70s that share these titles on archive.org are not used. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 65); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check.
